```{=html}
<div class="dlib-empty" id="dlibEmpty" style="display:none">No datasets match your filters. <button class="dlib-clear" onclick="dlibClear()">Clear filters</button></div>
</div>
</div></section>

</div>
<script>
// Charts across the site link here as data-library.html#dlib-<id> so the
// download link in each chart's expanded view lands on its exact dataset.
// Scroll to it and briefly highlight it so it's obvious which row matched.
(function(){
function focusFromHash(){
var hash = window.location.hash;
if (!hash || hash.length < 2) return;
var row = document.getElementById(hash.slice(1));
if (!row || !row.classList.contains('dlib-row')) return;
setTimeout(function(){
row.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
row.classList.add('dlib-row-highlight');
setTimeout(function(){ row.classList.remove('dlib-row-highlight'); }, 2600);
}, 60);
}
if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', focusFromHash);
else focusFromHash();
window.addEventListener('hashchange', focusFromHash);
})();
</script>
<style>
.dlib-row-highlight { animation: dlibHighlight 2.6s ease; }
@keyframes dlibHighlight {
0%   { background: rgba(240,165,0,0.22); }
100% { background: transparent; }
}
</style>
```
